facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; EU rules ban restrictions on payments.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Very likely: EU banks commonly offer foreign-currency accounts.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register as self-employed with VID through EDS, choosing general regime or micro-enterprise tax.
facts.L2_tax_id: A TIN from the tax administration; how to apply isn't confirmed.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at 25.5% up to €105,300, then 33%.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 21% VAT above €50,000; EU B2B services may need registration immediately.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online buyers can withdraw within 14 days.
facts.L7_incentives: Micro-enterprise tax: 25% of turnover replaces income tax and social contributions.

watch_out.text: Selling services to EU businesses can require a VAT number from the first sale.
